The user is interested in film photography, camera care, 120-film development and scanning, film stocks, darkroom techniques, and portrait photography (2023-05-27..2023-05-30). Assistant-mentioned resources and supplies included Steve Anchell’s The Darkroom Handbook; YouTube channels The Darkroom, Film Dev, and Analog Insights; Reddit communities r/Darkroom and r/AnalogPhotography; a developing tank and reels, thermometer, measuring cups, developer, stop bath, fixer, and washing supplies (2023-05-30). These were recommendations, not confirmed purchases or use.

By 2023-05-24, the user had participated in discussions of The Nightingale by Kristin Hannah and The Hate U Give by Angie Thomas. The user also wanted books about writing, publishing, and author platforms to help a Page Turners member preparing to publish a debut novel (2023-05-24), and had been considering The Power of Now by Eckhart Tolle as a starting point for spiritual growth and mindfulness (2023-05-30).

Naturalis dinosaur-encyclopedia thesis: The user developed a Bachelor's thesis project at The Hague University of Applied Sciences to create a user-centred clickable prototype for an interactive touchscreen dinosaur encyclopedia at Naturalis Museum in Leiden (2023-05-22; later summarized without a date). The intended experience would complement dinosaur exhibits with accessible, engaging, age-appropriate content, especially for children, using play, exploration, multimedia, and interactive features. The user asked for thesis-level context, problem statement, and goal wording and whether those sections fit report requirements (2023-05-22). The proposed research included desk research on the museum, its dinosaur collection, and interactive exhibits; context mapping; and interviews, observations, and surveys with young visitors. The user specifically wanted field research by visiting other museums and observing design choices and visitor engagement (date unspecified). The latest recorded state is a proposed prototype and research plan; no implementation or completed fieldwork is confirmed.

rollups.text: Social-media habits: The user took a 10-day social-media break from 2023-02-15 through 2023-02-25 and said it helped reset online habits; by 2023-05-21, the user reported doing pretty well since the break. To maintain healthier habits, the user planned set check-in times, website blockers during work hours, unfollowing accounts that negatively affected self-image, and social-media-free Sundays for reading and enjoyable activities (2023-05-21). The later measures are plans; the record does not confirm that the user implemented them.

By 2023-05-23, the user said they wrote down three things daily and that the habit helped clear their mind and focus on positive aspects of life. Separately, after reading The Power of Now, the user planned to journal daily about thoughts, feelings, experiences, and insights to integrate the book’s ideas (2023-05-30); the user was excited to start that reflective practice, but completion of the book or start of this second journal habit is not confirmed.

The user planned consistent training with basic commands, longer walks because exercise might be lacking, and techniques to help the dog stay calm around visitors (2023-05-22). No later outcome is recorded.

The user meal-preps on Sundays and brings healthy snacks to work; by 2023-05-30, they said meal-prepping had been going well. The weekday morning workout remains a plan, not a confirmed routine.
